title: Ridgmar Mall photos

pageHeader.title: Ridgmar Mall Photos
pageHeader.subTitle: Plans for demolition were announced in August 2026

text:
Ridgmar Mall along I-30 at Green Oaks Road opened in 1976. The mall has been in decline for a long time. Neiman Marcus closed in 2014, Sears closed around 2018, and JCPenney announced store closure in July 2026. Dillards became a clearance center in 2016. Visiting a "dead mall" can be an eerie experience, but my impression in August 2026 is that the mall interior is surprisingly up-to-date and in good condition — not neglected (except for a water feature, see photo).

On August 5, 2026, Ramrock Real Estate LLC announced it has acquired Ridgmar Mall and disclosed plans to transform the site into a warehouse complex to be called Ridgmar 30 Logistics Crossing. The schedule for demolition was not disclosed, but is expected to start within 12 to 18 months as of August 2026.
